procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
IRL 219480 did not ask to withdraw the protest after the arbitration meeting and neither boats took a Post-Race Penalty under RRS T1(a).
facts: The incident occurredon the last quarter of the first upwind leg of race #1.
At the moment ofthe incident the wind was around 15 knots and choppy water.
IRL 219480 was sailingon starboard on close-hauled course on a converging course with GER 225644 thatwas sailing on port on close-hauled course.
When the distance between them was two boat lengths, GER 225644 hailed to ask if she could pass.
When the distance between the boats was less than one boat length, the bow of IRL 219480 was aiming to the middle of the starboard side of GER 225644.
IRL 219480 crash tackedonto port and when the tack was completed the boats were overlapped bow to bowat lateral distance was half boat length.
conclusions: GER 225644 failed to keep claer of IRL 219480 on starboard tack, and broke RRS 10.
